summary: Assessment of Forge and the Godot/C# ecosystem (Chickensoft, gdUnit4, godot-ci, Godot assets) against this repo: 18 ranked recommendations by theme, what we already have, what to skip, licences.
validation: Documentation only. Three researchers read the repositories through gh and the web; the claims that matter most were checked against our tree (Dependabot, PR template, CODEOWNERS and the zero-match test guard already exist; main CI has no docs-only path filter). Items not verified are marked unverified in the document.
remaining: Adoption not started; rules-adjacent items 5 and 6 need the rules lead.
